sections.title: Retries that pile on
body: When an endpoint is struggling, every retry adds load and latency. Users wait for timeouts that were predictable.
sections.caption: A failing console where retries pile onto the queue.

sections.title: Closed, open, half-open
body: Gateway keeps a circuit breaker per endpoint. After a run of consecutive failures it opens and skips that endpoint; after a timeout it half-opens and lets a few requests through; enough successes close it again.
sections.caption: Three state chips with the failure and timeout thresholds.

sections.title: Breakers plus fallbacks
body: An open breaker simply moves the request to the next model in its fallback chain, so failure is fast and invisible.
sections.caption: An open switch stops traffic to the failing endpoint.
